home.title: Type a game. Play it.
home.lede: Describe a minigame in a sentence. A few seconds later it's a 3D level you can play, change and share.
home.ex1: Lava parkour up a volcano with moving platforms and 3 checkpoints
home.ex2: Coin hunt in a candy forest with beetles patrolling
home.ex3: A short race on floating ice islands with speed pads
home.ex4: Survive 40 seconds on a shrinking island of falling platforms
home.ex5: A glowing night maze with gems hidden in dead ends
home.left: {left} of {limit} new games left today · changing your games is unlimited
home.none_left: That's your {limit} new games for today. You can still change your games; new ones tomorrow (03:00 TRT).
home.search: Search by name, idea or creator…
home.nothing: Nothing matches. Try another word or type.
home.nothing_q: Nothing matches “{q}”. Try another word or type.
home.delete_confirm: Delete this game? It goes from every device.
home.no_game: That game doesn't exist (or was deleted).
home.connected: Connected. Getting the level from the host…
home.still: Still connecting… (your network may block direct connections)
home.daily_empty: No one has a time yet today. Be first.
home.testers_note: Testers get in like ambassadors (5 new games a day). Adding or removing works straight away.
home.testers_remove: Remove this tester? They lose access straight away (their games stay).
home.not_listed: This wallet ({wallet}) isn't on the test list.
home.sign_in: Sign in at the top right with a test wallet to get in.

play.p_climb: run into walls to climb them
play.keys_side: A/D or ←/→ run · Space or W jumps (hold to glide){shoot}
play.keys: WASD moves · Space jumps (hold to glide){look}{shoot}
play.keys_lock: · click to lock the mouse, move it to look
play.locked: You've had your free play. Unlock it for good: {price}, paid straight to the creator.
play.trial: Free first play · then {price} to unlock, paid to the creator
play.pvp_note: PvP: this one is for playing against friends. Open a room with 👥 and send them the link.
play.new_best: 👻 New best: next time you race this run's ghost
play.tip_ask: 💛 Liked it? Tip the creator (straight to their wallet) {tips}

pay.waiting: Waiting for the payment to go through…
pay.no_wallet: No wallet found: sign in on fly.ai first

party.how: Up to 4 players. Everyone races through their own copy of the level; you see each other live.
party.host_rematch: The host can start a rematch.

builder.ph: Tell the builder fly what to make or change… (T)
builder.label: Tell the builder fly
builder.parkour: Make the jumps harder|Add a moving platform|Add a secret gem route|Turn it into night
builder.race: Add speed pads|Add a shortcut|Make the track longer|Add walls to dodge
builder.coins: Hide more coins|Add patrolling beetles|Add a high coin tower|Make it a candy land
builder.survive: More chasing beetles|Add falling platforms|Add lava pools|Make it shorter and harder
builder.maze: Add keys and doors|Make the maze bigger|Hide gems in dead ends|Make it spooky
builder.shooter: Add more targets|Add a turret tower|Add cover walls|Switch to first person
builder.zombies: Add another nest|Add more hearts|One more wave|Add cover blocks
builder.hill: More beetles on the hill|Add bounce pads|Make the hill higher|Add lava around it

edit.hi: Hi! Tell me what game to build 👇
edit.hint_start: Click a piece and tell me what to change, or ask for something new.
edit.op_create: Ooh, nice idea. Let me picture it…
edit.chatter: Placing the ground…|Laying out the route…|A tricky jump here…|Hiding some coins…|Adding a few surprises…|Making it pretty…
edit.unreachable: Hmm, something can't be reached. Fixing it…
edit.built_but: Built it, but {problem}. Tap 🔧 Fix it.
edit.done_create: Done! {n} pieces. Press ▶ Play to try it.
edit.no_change: I didn't change anything. Try saying it another way?
edit.nothing_back: There's nothing to put back yet.
edit.put_back: Put it back the way it was.
edit.back_before: Back to how it was before “{prompt}”.
edit.price_set: Price set: {price} FLYAI after a free first play.
edit.price_failed: Couldn't set the price, try again in a moment.
edit.title: Title
edit.empty: Empty: tell the builder fly what to make
edit.hint_touch: Tap a piece to select it, drag the arrows to move it.
edit.hint_mouse: Click a piece to select it · drag the arrows to move · Del deletes · Ctrl+D copies
edit.talk_help: Talk to the builder fly in the box under the scene (or press T). Click a piece first to point at it: “make this bigger”.
edit.p_hover: Hover: hold jump to hang in the air
edit.price_note: Players get one free play, then pay you this to unlock it for good. Paid straight to your wallet.
edit.new_here: New pieces land where the camera is looking.
edit.start_note: Where the fly starts. Drag the arrows to move it; keep it on top of a block.
edit.nothing_sel: Nothing selected. Click a piece in the scene, or add one.
edit.colour_key: Colour (a key or switch opens doors of the same colour)
edit.colour_switch: Colour: opens doors of this colour, and shows or hides pieces set to it
edit.goes: Goes away when switch {n} is pressed
edit.solid_note: solid: the fly can stand on it
edit.copy_note: Select the see-through copy to move where it goes.

misc.no_reach: Can't reach the game maker right now
